title: Same-tick barcode bytes
hints: Inside an interrupt handler, only call functions whose names end in FromISR. They never block, and they report through a pointer whether you just woke a more important task.
Declare `BaseType_t xHigherPriorityTaskWoken = pdFALSE;`, pass `&xHigherPriorityTaskWoken` to `xQueueSendFromISR(g_rx_queue, &byte, ...)`, and check whether the return value is `pdPASS`.

The whole handler is: read the byte; `if (xQueueSendFromISR(g_rx_queue, &byte, &xHigherPriorityTaskWoken) != pdPASS) g_rx_dropped++;` and then `portYIELD_FROM_ISR(xHigherPriorityTaskWoken);` as the last line.
